mechanism_narrative: Residential mobility has stabilized at +17.3% over the past four weeks, indicating sustained lockdown compliance. This persistent elevation in home-based activity directly suppresses retail-and-recreation mobility by reducing the opportunity set for out-of-home consumption, driving RETAIL_REC further negative over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 5 percentage points over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining above +15%.

mechanism_narrative: Transit station mobility has remained depressed at -60.4% in t-0w, preventing commuter-driven foot traffic to retail corridors. The persistence of transit suppression acts as a binding constraint on retail recovery; retail cannot rebound until transit mobility recovers by at least 15 percentage points week-on-week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises by more than 10 percentage points in any week where TRANSIT does not increase by at least 15 points from the prior week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase by at least 8 percentage points in any week where both GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT rise simultaneously by their specified thresholds.
